note: Majority: null. The Civil Code (Decreto Ley 106) was sought on 2026-10-31: the Ministry of Government's copy (mingob.gob.gt, repeju) answered 404, the OAS copy 403, and the Judicial Branch (oj.gob.gt) and Congress (congreso.gob.gt, an Incapsula page) didn't serve it; a web search found no other official copy. Work: the Labour Code (Código de Trabajo, Decreto 1441, as published by the Ministry of Labour, mintrabajo.gob.gt, 2026 upload): art. 148(e) forbids the work of minors under fourteen; art. 149 shortens the working day of those over fourteen; art. 150: the Inspección General de Trabajo may, in qualified exceptional cases, give written authorisation for a minor under fourteen to work, on proof that the child works as an apprentice or must help a family in extreme poverty, that the work is light, and that schooling is met. So general employment from 14. Performers: the Code makes no exception for performing; art. 150's authorisation rests on apprenticeship or family poverty, not on performing, so the form holds barred (my reading). The Ley de Protección Integral de la Niñez y Adolescencia (Decreto 27-2003) was not read. Service: null. The Ley del Servicio Cívico (Decreto 20-2003) and the defence ministry (mindef.mil.gt, which didn't answer) were not read.

sources.title: Código de Trabajo, Decreto 1441 (Ministerio de Trabajo y Previsión Social)
sources.said: El trabajo de los menores de catorce años. ... La Inspección General de Trabajo puede extender, en casos de excepción calificada, autorizaciones escritas para permitir el trabajo ordinario diurno de los menores de catorce años ... Que el menor de edad va a trabajar en vía de aprendizaje o que tiene necesidad de cooperar en la economía familiar
